# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools-doc.mjs from tools/list. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run docs:tools`. -->

SenseKit-MCP 1.0.0 registers **50 tools** when every group is enabled, mutations are allowed and certificate material is configured. With the default `QSEOW_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=false`, 16 of them are not registered at all, leaving 34.

Markers used below:

- **mutation-gated**: registered only when `QSEOW_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true`. With the default, the tool is absent from `tools/list`.
- **needs certificate files**: registered only when `QSEOW_CERT_PATH` and `QSEOW_CERT_KEY_PATH` are set, in any auth mode. These tools call the Proxy Service REST API, which accepts only certificate authentication.
- **Inputs**: nested rows such as `measures[].label` describe the object form of an input; "Required" is relative to the parent object.
- **Annotations** are the MCP tool hints the server declares (`readOnlyHint`, `destructiveHint`, `idempotentHint`, `openWorldHint`). Clients can use them to apply their own confirmation policy.

Tool groups are chosen with `QSEOW_TOOL_GROUPS` (see [configuration.md](configuration.md)).

## Analyst

Group `analyst`. Ask questions of app data through the Engine (QIX), plus the read-only troubleshooting tools: sheets, objects, expression search, master items, lineage.

### list_engine_apps

always registered with its group

List apps visible to the current engine session (id, name, last reload). Paged.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `offset` | integer | no | Skip this many items (default 0); min 0 |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max items to return (default 100, max 1000); > 0; max 1000 |

### get_app_data_model

always registered with its group

Tables and fields of an app's data model — the map an analyst needs before querying.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appId` | GUID | yes | App id (GUID) |

### evaluate_expression

always registered with its group

Evaluate a Qlik expression against an app in the current selection state, e.g. "Sum(Sales)" or "Count(distinct Customer)". The response carries a trust envelope: expression validation warnings (a misspelled field returns null/0 WITHOUT erroring) and the active selections the value was computed under.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appId` | GUID | yes | App id (GUID) |
| `expression` | string | yes | Qlik expression without leading = |

### create_hypercube

always registered with its group

Build a hypercube (group-by query) over an app: dimensions + measure expressions, returns tabular data honoring current selections. The core analyst query tool.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appId` | GUID | yes | App id (GUID) |
| `dimensions` | string[] | yes | Field names or dimension expressions |
| `measures` | string[] | yes | Measure expressions, e.g. 'Sum(Sales)' |
| `maxRows` | integer | no | Row limit (default 200); > 0; max 10000 |
| `sortByMeasureDesc` | integer | no | Sort by measure index (0-based), descending |

### select_field_values

always registered with its group

Select values in a field (session-scoped; affects subsequent hypercubes/expressions in this MCP session). Numeric values are matched numerically — pass numbers as numbers (or numeric strings; both work). Returns the resulting selected count so a silently-widened or missed selection is visible.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: false, `destructiveHint`: false, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appId` | GUID | yes | App id (GUID) |
| `field` | string | yes | Field name |
| `values` | array of (string or number) | yes | Values to select |
| `toggle` | boolean | no | Toggle instead of replace (default false) |

### crosscheck_expression

always registered with its group

Adversarial self-check for a numeric answer: evaluates the expression as a single total AND as a group-by decomposition over a dimension, then compares total vs sum-of-groups. Agreement is strong evidence the number is internally consistent; disagreement flags a non-additive measure (Count DISTINCT, ratios, set-analysis pinned to chart scope) or a scoping bug — exactly the cases where a single evaluated number can mislead. Use before presenting high-stakes figures.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appId` | GUID | yes | App id (GUID) |
| `expression` | string | yes | Measure expression, e.g. 'Sum(Sales)' |
| `groupBy` | string | yes | Dimension field to decompose over |

### search_expressions

always registered with its group

Find where an expression fragment, field, or KPI term is used across an ENTIRE app: every object's properties (with owning sheet), master measures/dimensions, variables, and the load script. The 'where does this number come from' tool. NOTE: on a PUBLISHED app the engine hides the load script from user identities, so script matches only appear for unpublished apps you own — copy_app the target and search the copy to include script hits.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appId` | GUID | yes | App id (GUID) |
| `term` | string | yes | Search term, e.g. a field name, measure label, or expression fragment; min length 2 |
| `caseSensitive` | boolean | no | Default false |
| `maxMatches` | integer | no | Cap on returned matches (default 100); > 0; max 500 |

### evaluate_master_measure

always registered with its group

Evaluate a master measure by id or title in the current selection state. Fetches the measure's expression and evaluates it — the KPI -> value step of a trace. (Referencing a master measure as [Name] in a raw expression resolves to a FIELD, not the measure — this tool exists so you never hit that trap.)

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appId` | GUID | yes | App id (GUID) |
| `measureId` | string | no | Master measure id |
| `title` | string | no | Master measure title (used when measureId is omitted) |

### get_app_lineage

always registered with its group

Data lineage of an app's load script as the engine sees it: every LOAD/STORE source and target (files, QVDs, databases, resident, inline, binary). The app -> source step of a trace. NOTE: on a PUBLISHED app the engine denies lineage to user identities (certificate/internal identities bypass this) — copy_app the target and read the copy's lineage.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appId` | GUID | yes | App id (GUID) |

## Developer

Group `developer`. Load scripts, reloads and app lifecycle; the sheet and chart builder with its render-validation gate; master-item governance.

### get_script

always registered with its group

Get an app's load script. Embedded credentials (inline connection strings, secret-bearing variables) are redacted — scripts with masked values cannot be round-tripped through set_script.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appId` | GUID | yes | App id (GUID) |

### check_script

always registered with its group

Syntax-check an app's current load script. Returns [] when clean.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appId` | GUID | yes | App id (GUID) |

### validate_sheet

always registered with its group

Quality gate for the UI layer: validate that a sheet's objects (or one object) will actually render — definition errors, unknown/missing visualization types, unknown fields in expressions, empty-data cubes, pivot qMode traps, dangling master-item links, filterpane listbox children, and cell-placement problems (unplaced objects, orphan cells, off-grid, overlaps). The engine accepts definitions the client draws blank; this catches those before a user does.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `idempotentHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appId` | GUID | yes | App id (GUID) |
| `sheetId` | string | no | Sheet to validate (all placed objects + placement lint) |
| `objectId` | string | no | Single object to validate (placement lint skipped) |

### add_sheet_object

**mutation-gated**

Add a visualization to a sheet and IMMEDIATELY run the render-validation gate on it — creation and quality check in one call; the response's validation.status tells you whether it will actually render. Supported types: kpi, gauge, barchart, linechart, combochart, piechart, scatterplot, treemap, bulletchart, boxplot, histogram, distributionplot, waterfallchart, mekkochart, table, pivot-table, listbox, text-image, filterpane, action-button. Dimensions are field names, calculated dimensions or master dimensions; measures are expressions or master measures, with optional label, number format and color. A filterpane gets one listbox per dimension. An action-button is a button: title is its label, options.color its background, options.navigateTo where a click goes (a sheet, the next/previous/first/last sheet, or a website). Refuses unknown fields, calculated-dimension errors, measure syntax errors, unknown master ids and unknown target sheets BEFORE creating. MUTATION (additive).

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: false, `destructiveHint`: false, `idempotentHint`: false, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appId` | GUID | yes | App id (GUID) |
| `sheetId` | string | yes | Sheet id (from create_sheet or list_sheets) |
| `visualization` | string | yes | Visualization type, e.g. 'barchart' |
| `title` | string | no |  |
| `dimensions` | array of (string or object) | no | Field names, or objects {field\|expression\|libraryId, label?, sort?, includeNulls?, pivotColumn?} — exactly one of field/expression ('=Year(Date)', a calculated dimension)/libraryId (master dimension) |
| `dimensions[].field` | string | no | Field name |
| `dimensions[].expression` | string | no | Calculated dimension, e.g. '=Year(OrderDate)' |

| `dimensions[].label` | string | no | Column/axis label |
| `dimensions[].sort` | "asc", "desc", "loadOrder" | no |  |
| `dimensions[].includeNulls` | boolean | no | false hides the null ('-') row, like unticking 'Include null values' (charts and tables) |
| `dimensions[].pivotColumn` | boolean | no | pivot-table only: show this dimension as columns; column dimensions must come after the row dimensions |

| `measures[].numberFormat.decimals` | integer | no | Decimals when no pattern is given; min 0; max 15 |

### update_sheet_object

**mutation-gated**

Rebuild an existing builder-supported object in place (same object id, same visualization type) and re-run the render-validation gate. Omitted title/dimensions/measures are carried over from the current object (labels, number formats, master links included). Options are NOT merged: pass the full styling you want — omitted options revert to the defaults (an action-button keeps its navigation unless options.navigateTo is given). Same pre-flight refusals as add_sheet_object. MUTATION: overwrites the object's properties.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: false, `destructiveHint`: true, `idempotentHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| `options.navigateTo.sheetId` | string | no | goToSheet: target sheet id (list_sheets) |
| `options.navigateTo.url` | string | no | openWebsite: http(s):// or mailto: URL |
| `options.navigateTo.sameWindow` | boolean | no | openWebsite: open in the same tab (default: new tab) |

### move_sheet_object

**mutation-gated**

Move/resize an object's cell on a sheet (grows the grid if needed, like add_sheet_object) and run placement lint. Also places an object that has no cell yet. MUTATION.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: false, `destructiveHint`: false, `idempotentHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appId` | GUID | yes | App id (GUID) |
| `sheetId` | string | yes | Sheet id |
| `objectId` | string | yes | Object id (a child of the sheet) |
| `position` | object | yes | Grid cell (sheet grid is columns x rows, default 24x12) |
| `position.col` | integer | yes | min 0 |
| `position.row` | integer | yes | min 0 |
| `position.colspan` | integer | yes | > 0 |
| `position.rowspan` | integer | yes | > 0 |

### delete_sheet_object

**mutation-gated**

Delete an object from a sheet (and its children, e.g. a filterpane's listboxes) and remove its cell. MUTATION: irreversible once saved.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: false, `destructiveHint`: true, `idempotentHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appId` | GUID | yes | App id (GUID) |
| `sheetId` | string | yes | Sheet id |
| `objectId` | string | yes | Object id (a child of the sheet) |

### create_master_measure

**mutation-gated**

Create a master (library) measure. The expression is checked with the engine first and refused on any error or unknown field; a duplicate title is refused. Link it into charts via add_sheet_object measures: [{ libraryId }]. Number formats are NOT yet render-verified. MUTATION (additive).

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: false, `destructiveHint`: false, `idempotentHint`: false, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appId` | GUID | yes | App id (GUID) |
| `title` | string | yes | Master item title (shown in the asset panel); min length 1 |
| `expression` | string | yes | Measure expression, e.g. 'Sum(Sales)'; min length 1 |
| `label` | string | no | Label shown in charts (default: title) |
| `description` | string | no |  |
| `tags` | string[] | no |  |
| `numberFormat` | object | no |  |
| `numberFormat.type` | "auto", "number", "integer", "percent", "money", "date", "custom" | yes |  |
| `numberFormat.pattern` | string | no | Qlik format pattern, e.g. '#,##0.00', '0.0%', '$#,##0', 'YYYY-MM-DD' (required for custom) |
| `numberFormat.decimals` | integer | no | Decimals when no pattern is given; min 0; max 15 |

### create_master_dimension

**mutation-gated**

Create a master (library) dimension: one field (single) or several (drill-down group, top level first). Fields must exist in the data model; calculated fields ('=...') are checked with the engine. A duplicate title is refused. Link it into charts via add_sheet_object dimensions: [{ libraryId }]. MUTATION (additive).

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: false, `destructiveHint`: false, `idempotentHint`: false, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appId` | GUID | yes | App id (GUID) |
| `title` | string | yes | Master item title; min length 1 |
| `fields` | string[] | yes | Field names (or '=...' calculated); >1 = drill-down; min 1 items; max 20 items |
| `label` | string | no | Label shown in charts (default: title; drill-down: first field) |
| `description` | string | no |  |
| `tags` | string[] | no |  |

### delete_master_item

**mutation-gated**

Delete a master measure or dimension. First finds every object that links to it (qLibraryId) and REFUSES when any exists — those charts would render an error tile — unless force is true. MUTATION: irreversible once saved.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: false, `destructiveHint`: true, `idempotentHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appId` | GUID | yes | App id (GUID) |
| `kind` | "measure", "dimension" | yes |  |
| `id` | string | yes | Master item id (list_master_measures / list_master_dimensions); min length 1 |
| `force` | boolean | no | Delete even when objects still link to it (default false) |

## Admin

Group `admin`. Govern and operate the site through the Repository (QRS): inventory, tasks, reload forensics, engine health, security-rule audit, proxy sessions.

### qrs_about

always registered with its group

Qlik Sense server version and build info from the Repository Service. Cheap health check.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `idempotentHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

No inputs.

### service_status

always registered with its group

Health of all Qlik services on every node (repository, proxy, engine, scheduler, printing).

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `idempotentHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

No inputs.

### license_summary

always registered with its group

License overview: serial, edition, expiry, and professional/analyzer access allocations.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `idempotentHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

No inputs.

### list_apps

always registered with its group

List apps in the repository with owner, stream, size, and reload time. Optional QRS filter, e.g. "name sw 'Sales'" or "stream.name eq 'Everyone'". Paged.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filter` | string | no | QRS filter expression |
| `offset` | integer | no | Skip this many items (default 0); min 0 |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max items to return (default 100, max 1000); > 0; max 1000 |

### list_streams

always registered with its group

List streams (publish targets) with owner. Paged.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `offset` | integer | no | Skip this many items (default 0); min 0 |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max items to return (default 100, max 1000); > 0; max 1000 |

### list_tasks

always registered with its group

List reload tasks with enabled state and last execution result. Optional QRS filter. Paged.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filter` | string | no | QRS filter expression |
| `offset` | integer | no | Skip this many items (default 0); min 0 |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max items to return (default 100, max 1000); > 0; max 1000 |

### qrs_search

always registered with its group

Generic QRS entity search: any entity type (app, user, stream, reloadtask, dataconnection, extension, tag, customproperty, systemrule, ...) with an optional QRS filter expression. The governance power tool. Credential-bearing fields are redacted on every entity type. Paged.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| `entity` | string | yes | QRS entity type, e.g. 'app', 'systemrule', 'tag' |

| `limit` | integer | no | Max items to return (default 100, max 1000); > 0; max 1000 |

### get_reload_log

always registered with its group

Why did a reload fail? Last execution result of a reload task (status, timing, execution detail timeline) plus the tail of the reload script log. The first tool to reach for on FinishedFail.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `idempotentHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `taskId` | GUID | yes | Reload task id (see list_tasks) |
| `tailLines` | integer | no | Script-log lines to return from the end (default 200); > 0; max 2000 |

### engine_healthcheck

always registered with its group

Engine health: version, saturated flag, memory, CPU, active/loaded app counts, session and user counts. The 'is the engine the problem?' tool.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `idempotentHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

No inputs.

### security_rule_audit

always registered with its group

Audit the site's security rules: every Security-category system rule with decoded actions, plus lint findings (disabled default rules, wildcard resource filters, unconditional write grants). Findings are review prompts, not verdicts. Paged.

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `idempotentHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `includeRules` | boolean | no | Include the full rule list, not just counts + findings (default true) |
| `offset` | integer | no | Skip this many items (default 0); min 0 |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max items to return (default 100, max 1000); > 0; max 1000 |

### list_user_sessions

always registered with its group · **needs certificate files**

Active proxy sessions for a user on a virtual proxy (default: the default proxy). Certificate-backed (QPS REST is certificate-only). Answers 'is this user logged in, and how many times?'

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: true, `idempotentHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `directory` | string | yes | User directory, e.g. 'LAB' |
| `userId` | string | yes | User id, e.g. 'qservice' |
| `virtualProxy` | string | no | Virtual proxy prefix to query (omit for the default proxy) |

### end_user_sessions

**mutation-gated** · **needs certificate files**

Log a user out of a virtual proxy by deleting ALL their proxy sessions there. MUTATION: the user's open hub/QMC tabs die immediately. Certificate-backed (QPS REST is certificate-only).

Annotations: `readOnlyHint`: false, `destructiveHint`: true, `idempotentHint`: true, `openWorldHint`: false

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `directory` | string | yes | User directory |
| `userId` | string | yes | User id |
| `virtualProxy` | string | no | Virtual proxy prefix (omit for the default proxy) |

## Summary

- Mutation-gated (16): `start_task`, `end_user_sessions`, `set_script`, `reload_app`, `create_app`, `copy_app`, `delete_app`, `publish_app`, `create_sheet`, `add_sheet_object`, `update_sheet_object`, `move_sheet_object`, `delete_sheet_object`, `create_master_measure`, `create_master_dimension`, `delete_master_item`
- Needs certificate files (2): `list_user_sessions`, `end_user_sessions`
